description: Source code for an inter-process communication (IPC) message service implementation in Zephyr RTOS, handling message buffers, mailbox communication, and work queue management.

methods.name: mbox_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes mailbox by disabling and unregistering callback.

methods.name: notify_process
methods.description: Handles notification work, reschedules if not in ready state.

methods.name: is_endpoint_ready
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint is in ready state.

methods.name: reserve_tx_buffer_if_unused
methods.description: Reserves transmit buffer with optional mutex lock.

methods.name: release_tx_buffer
methods.description: Releases transmit buffer with optional mutex unlock.

methods.name: data_available
methods.description: Returns amount of data available in receive buffer.

methods.name: submit_mbox_work
methods.description: Submits mailbox work to work queue.

methods.name: submit_work_if_buffer_free_and_data_available
methods.description: Submits mailbox work if data is available.

methods.name: mbox_callback_process
methods.description: Processes mailbox callback, handles received data.

methods.name: mbox_callback
methods.description: Mailbox callback function, triggers work submission.

methods.name: mbox_init
methods.description: Initializes mailbox with callback and enables it.

methods.name: icmsg_open
methods.description: Opens and initializes IPC message endpoint.

methods.name: icmsg_send
methods.description: Sends a message through the IPC channel.

methods.name: work_q_init
methods.description: Initializes the work queue if enabled.
